title: What the Hypothesis Engine is
description: The engine runs the scientific method at machine speed: given observations, it explodes a diverse set of candidate explanations, scores each on evidence fit, feasibility, and test cost, then prunes to a prioritized shortlist with test plans. Breadth prevents missing the answer; pruning prevents drowning in possibilities.

title: Hypothesis data model

title: Diverse generation algorithm
description: Generation explodes across strategies: variations on known explanations, analogies from other fields, mechanism-first constructions, and deliberate contrarians. title: Three-axis prioritization algorithm
description: Pruning scores each hypothesis on evidence fit, feasibility, and testing cost — then combines them into a priority that favors strong evidence, possible tests, and cheap experiments. A brilliant but untestable hypothesis ranks below a good testable one: science advances on what can be checked.

title: Failure modes: explosion without pruning and pet hypotheses
description: The engine fails when generation floods without pruning (analysis paralysis) or when pet hypotheses survive pruning by sentiment. Defenses: hard pruning budgets, score transparency that exposes favoritism, and audit trails on every keep decision. The numbers prune, not the preferences.
